name: Playwright
description: Write, run, and maintain real Playwright end-to-end tests in your own repository.
examples: Write a Playwright test for the login flow against staging
Add end-to-end coverage for guest checkout in my web repo
Figure out why the signup e2e test is failing and open a fix PR
Reproduce this bug in the browser and capture the evidence
Write Playwright tests for the dashboard and open a pull request
long_description: Playwright turns an agent into a QA automation engineer that works inside your codebase. It reproduces a user flow in a real browser first, then writes production-grade Playwright tests that match your repository's conventions (fixtures, page objects, storageState auth), runs them to green, captures screenshots and video as evidence, and opens a pull request. Bugs are reported with a clear reproduction; tests are never weakened just to pass. Works with the Browser and Drive runtime capabilities and the GitHub plugin.
